title: Pre-Exam Certificate Checker for Hostel Friends
title_te: హాస్టల్ స్నేహితుల కోసం సర్టిఫికేట్ ఫోటో చెకర్
problem: My hostel friend missed her scholarship money last year because her caste certificate photo was blurry and rejected by the officer.
idea: A photo checker. Before uploading a certificate for a scholarship, we show the photo to the camera and it gives a green tick if it is clear, or asks us to take it again.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: Is this certificate photo OK?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine checks the photo. Here, tap what the photo looks like.
widgets.question: The certificate photo is…

options.label: Sharp, flat, all 4 corners seen
options.result: Green tick! Clear photo. Ready to upload.
options.te: గ్రీన్ టిక్! ఫోటో స్పష్టంగా ఉంది. అప్‌లోడ్ చేయవచ్చు.

options.label: Blurry letters
options.result: Blurry! Hold the phone still and take it again.
options.te: మసకగా ఉంది! ఫోన్ కదలకుండా పట్టుకుని మళ్ళీ తీయండి.

options.label: Dark or shadow on it
options.result: Too dark. Take the photo near a window in daylight.
options.te: చీకటిగా ఉంది. కిటికీ దగ్గర పగటి వెలుతురులో తీయండి.

options.label: Corner cut off
options.result: Part is missing. Fit the whole paper in the photo.
options.te: కొంత భాగం లేదు. పూర్తి కాగితం ఫోటోలో రావాలి.

items.text: Name on certificate matches Aadhaar and school records
items.te: సర్టిఫికేట్‌లో పేరు ఆధార్, స్కూల్ రికార్డులతో సరిపోతుంది

items.text: All words can be read clearly
File size and type match the website's rule
items.te: ఫైల్ సైజు, రకం వెబ్‌సైట్ నియమం ప్రకారం ఉన్నాయి

items.text: Certificate is still valid (check the date)
A copy is saved in the phone and a printout kept

bands.text: Perfect! Upload it before the last date.
Not ready. Ask the warden or teacher for help.

how: Collect sample photos of any printed paper (not real certificates): sharp ones and blurry ones.
In Teachable Machine (Image Project), make classes: Clear, Blurry, Dark.
Add about 40 photos to each class, train and Export the model.
In PictoBlox with the ML extension, show a green tick sprite for 'Clear' and a red cross for others.
Ask Gemini for tips on scanning documents with a phone.
Help hostel friends check their photos before the scholarship (ePASS) last date.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Give 6 simple tips to take a clear phone photo of a certificate for an online scholarship application (light, angle, focus, file size). Use simple English and Telugu.
